typescript.role: type checking and declaration generation only

description: Self-contained packaging derived from frozen WASM inputs. Only name/producers custom sections are removed; standard-section bytes are unchanged. Current working-tree JS is identified separately.

packaging.diagnostics: Function names and producer metadata are omitted from embedded WASM. WASM stack traces may show indices instead of names. Original symbolled inputs and their provenance remain at binaryInputs paths.

scalarPayload.workerConstruction: Replace one private scalar-worker placeholder at concurrency-1 initialization only; runtime instances remain separate.

priorAdaptation.reason: Forward async child initialization rejection through Worker error instead of waiting for the parent operation deadline.

helper.changes: Direct self-spawn from the factory-owned helper Blob URL; preserve child rejection forwarding; use the generated object-form initializer.

scalar.change: Remove default external WASM URL discovery; initialization always supplies embedded bytes or the child module/memory.

shared.change: Remove default external WASM URL discovery; initialization always supplies embedded bytes or the child module/memory.
